body.statement: Let \(\beta=\min\{c/(3C),2c/(C+2c)\}\) and \(N_0=\left\lceil\{(G+\sqrt{G^2+4\beta})/(2\beta)\}^2\right\rceil\). Uniformly for \(p\in\mathcal P\), \(\gamma\in[-G,G]\), and \(N\ge N_0\), \(1\le\lceil Na(p)+\gamma\sqrt N\rceil\le N-1\).
body.justification: The deterministic bound makes every finite-chain generator and staffing rule well-defined without hidden clipping.
body.gap: The anchor invokes sufficiently large populations but does not state a compact-uniform enrollment threshold for the entire rate and staffing box.
body.consumer: A certificate checker can reject infeasible enrollment values before evaluating the stochastic model.
body.proof_tex:
Put \(x=\sqrt N\).  By the rate bounds and rate membership,
\[
 a(p)=\frac{\lambda}{\lambda+\tau+\nu}\geq \frac{c}{3C}\geq\beta,
 \qquad
 1-a(p)=\frac{\tau+\nu}{\lambda+\tau+\nu}
 \geq \frac{2c}{C+2c}\geq\beta .
\]
The positive root of \(\beta x^2-Gx-1=0\) is
\(r=(G+\sqrt{G^2+4\beta})/(2\beta)\).  The definition of \(N_0\) and the
assumption \(N\geq N_0\) imply \(x\geq r\), hence
\[
 \beta N-G\sqrt N\geq1.
\]
Using \(|\gamma|\leq G\) gives
\[
 Na(p)+\gamma\sqrt N\geq \beta N-G\sqrt N\geq1
\]
and
\[
 Na(p)+\gamma\sqrt N
 \leq N(1-\beta)+G\sqrt N
 =N-\{\beta N-G\sqrt N\}\leq N-1.
\]
Taking ceilings preserves both integer bounds, proving the claim uniformly.
